shared_elements: low-relief carving of a frontal anthropomorphic/supernatural face or mask
headdress or headband with repeated vertical/rectangular elements above the face
rectangular or curvilinear geometric motifs arranged in bands
large-scale monumental relief on an irregular boulder-like block
justification: Both surfaces show a broad, frontal mask-like face with paired eye elements surmounted by a banded headdress of repeated rectangular/scroll elements, carved in shallow schematic relief with heavy outlines and geometric infill on a massive irregular block. The clearest difference is that A depicts a complete standing figure with a body bearing a central disc, pendant ornaments and a belt band below the head, whereas B shows only a horizontally oriented head-and-headdress composition with no body or disc motif visible.
